notes.title: 2.0 Build Is now Live
notes.content:
This bumper 2.0 Updates include:

[list]
[*] New Funhouse Levels
[*] New Bonus Levels
[*] New Bonus Fruits to collect
[*] New Mini Map to find all the Bananas
[*] Improved Banana Layouts for all levels
[*] Stage End Transitions and Animations
[*] Animated Menus and Improved Transitions
[*] Improved controller support in menus
[*] Minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Leaderboards and New Levels Added
notes.content:
Check out the latest Go Bananas Update!

Now with leaderboards to track your score over multiple rounds, and a whole bunch of delicious new levels and secret monkey boxes! What could possibly be inside?
